result.summary: The page is generally well-structured. One notable visual defect appears in the delivery-promotion banner text.

issues.description: The promo banner subtitle overflows/collides with the decorative artwork on the right; the final price text (“€10”) sits on top of the green circular illustration and is visually obscured.
issues.suggestion: Constrain the subtitle text area or add right padding/reserve space for the artwork so the full message remains clear and unobstructed.
